maddeler.e:
أرتعش (form VIII)
# أَرْتَعِشُ (ʔartaʕišu) /ʔar.ta.ʕi.ʃu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَعَشَ (irtaʕaša)
# أَرْتَعِشَ (ʔartaʕiša) /ʔar.ta.ʕi.ʃa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَعَشَ (irtaʕaša)
# أَرْتَعِشْ (ʔartaʕiš) /ʔar.ta.ʕiʃ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِرْتَعَشَ (irtaʕaša)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
